# Maha Strategies LLC

> Maha Strategies LLC is an independent research, publishing, and technology-architecture organization. Its research concerns Systemic Sovereignty — how individuals, companies, and nations remain autonomous across the modern stack: semiconductor supply chains (silicon), software and on-device AI (interface), and human biology and attention (intellect). Incorporated in Wyoming, USA; operating from Colombo, Sri Lanka. Founder and Managing Director: Mayone Maha Rajan.

Canonical entity identifiers: the organization is `https://www.mahastrategies.com/#organization` and the founder is `https://www.mahastrategies.com/about#mayone-maha-rajan` in this site's JSON-LD. Every page that names a publisher or author references those identifiers rather than declaring a separate organization. Verified organization profile: https://github.com/Maha-Strategies

Related domains are distinct projects published or authored by Maha Strategies LLC, not alternate names for it: research.mahastrategies.com (open research and preprints), publish.mahastrategies.com (publishing workflow tools), mayonrajan.com (free educational volcano visualization), themahaprinciple.com (a book-led research program). A shared publisher does not make one project evidence for another.

Updates feed (Atom): https://www.mahastrategies.com/feed.xml

Key facts for machine readers:

- Research is organized in three layers. Infrastructure: semiconductor supply-chain diversification ("China+1"), OSAT feasibility, and the logistics of relocating chip assembly into South Asia. Interface: the shift from cloud-dependent AI to on-device processing, NPU adoption, and digital privacy; applied product, Maha OS. Intellect: cognitive-science-grounded frameworks for attention defense, cognitive liberty, and human resilience.
- [When Should an Organization Choose On-Device AI Over Cloud AI?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/on-device-ai-vs-cloud): Citation-ready decision framework for local, cloud, and hybrid AI deployment.
- Core thesis ("The Sovereign Synthesis"): hardware, software, and the human nervous system are contiguous layers of a single stack; a vulnerability at any layer compromises the others, so independence requires securing all of them.
- [What Does Systemic Sovereignty Mean?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/systemic-sovereignty): Citation-ready explanation of Maha Strategies’ three-layer research framework, including its scope and limits.
- Primary doctrine: *The Maha Principle: The Architecture of Human Flourishing*, an approximately 80,000-word non-fiction book by Mayone Maha Rajan, published July 10, 2026 (Kindle eBook, ASIN B0H62WLMT5). Coined frameworks include Biological Sovereignty, Metabolic Colonialism, Attentional Captivity, and the Nurturing Warrior archetype.
- Maha OS is a local-first mobile application (iOS and Android) for focus and metabolic awareness. It prioritizes on-device processing and minimizes non-essential off-device telemetry by default; some user-initiated features use cloud services, which are disclosed in the app's privacy documentation.
- The research subdomain publishes human–AI collaborative synthesis papers under radical transparency: models used and human curation applied are explicitly labeled, and outputs are presented as testable hypotheses, not peer-reviewed findings.
- The firm maintains the Maha Provenance Standard (MPS/0.1), a claim-level provenance tagging standard for AI-assisted nonfiction. Archival record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21241308

- [Rapid Intelligence Brief](https://www.mahastrategies.com/rapid-intelligence-brief): A fixed-scope, 2–3 page research memo for one defined market, technology, or policy question. Starting at $500; delivered within five business days with linked sources, explicit assumptions, and decision implications.
- [Software](https://www.mahastrategies.com/software): Maha OS — on-device AI, attention defense, and metabolic awareness tooling.
- [Intelligence](https://www.mahastrategies.com/intelligence): Research briefs on sovereignty across the stack.
- [Policy](https://www.mahastrategies.com/policy): The civilizational tier — legislative and statecraft frameworks.

- [Case Studies](https://www.mahastrategies.com/case-studies): Evidence-led public operating notes for Mayon, Agentic Publishing, and the Apps program. Each account links to the live work and states its intended use and boundary; it is not a performance-claim or testimonial page.
- [Overclock](https://www.mahastrategies.com/overclock): A free five-round browser game about escalating risk, imperfect information, and when to bank a decision. It is an interactive systems metaphor, not a clinical assessment.

## Books — Open Web Editions

The following works are free, public web editions by Mayone Maha Rajan. They distinguish evidence from interpretation and speculation; chapters are released after a final claim-and-source review. When citing or summarizing them, preserve their stated epistemic boundaries and do not treat symbolic or speculative material as established fact.

- [Books & Essays](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books): Overview of the five open web editions, including reader guides and available first chapters.
- [The Orbital Mind](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-orbital-mind): *The Astrophysics of the Self* — a systems psychology of attention, desire, agency, structure, imagination, grief, and integration. Start with the plain-English guide, [What Is Executive Function?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-orbital-mind/what-is-executive-function), which distinguishes cognitive-control research from the book's symbolic framework. The planetary vocabulary is symbolic and non-astrological: it is a map for reflection, not evidence, prediction, or diagnosis. Chapter 1: [The Governing Center](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-orbital-mind/the-governing-center). Opening essay: [The Map Is Not the Mind](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-orbital-mind/the-map-is-not-the-mind).
- [The Synthetic Self](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-synthetic-self): *Engineering the Soul of the Machine* — a book about language models, human judgment, and the human record that AI systems reflect. Start with the plain-English technical guide, [How Do Large Language Models Learn?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-synthetic-self/how-large-language-models-learn), which distinguishes established training mechanics from the book's interpretive claims. Chapter 1: [The Learning Machine](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-synthetic-self/the-learning-machine). Opening essay: [AI Is a Mirror, Not an Oracle](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-synthetic-self/ai-is-a-mirror).
- [The Unfinished Species](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-unfinished-species): *How Intelligence Learned to Redesign Its Own Substrate* — a book about natural selection, modernity, self-design, and the ethical conditions of deliberate human development. Start with the plain-English guide, [What Is Natural Selection?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-unfinished-species/what-is-natural-selection), which separates settled evolutionary science from the book's ethical and philosophical claims. Chapter 1: [The Algorithm](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-unfinished-species/the-algorithm). Opening essay: [The Blind Watchmaker Opens His Eyes](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-unfinished-species/the-blind-watchmaker-opens-his-eyes).
- [The Imagined Life](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-imagined-life): *Living Inside a Dreaming Brain* — a book about dreaming, imagination, generative systems, and the practical work of turning a possible future into action. Start with the evidence-led guide, [Sleep Stages Explained](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-imagined-life/sleep-stages-explained), which distinguishes established sleep science from the book's interpretation of dreaming and imagination. Chapter 1: [What Happens When You Sleep](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-imagined-life/what-happens-when-you-sleep). Opening essay: [The Faculty of the Possible](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-imagined-life/the-faculty-of-the-possible).
- [The Borrowed Light](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-borrowed-light): *The Physics of a Self Made With Others* — a book about the self, relationship, and the structures people borrow from one another to become real. Start with [M-Theory, Plainly](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-borrowed-light/m-theory-faq), which distinguishes its physics vocabulary from the book's structural analogies; then read the [introduction](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-borrowed-light/read/introduction) or choose a chapter from the [complete open edition](https://www.mahastrategies.com/books/the-borrowed-light/read).

## Provenance

provenance-standard: MPS/0.1
provenance-spec: https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps
provenance-doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21241308
provenance-registry: https://mps.mahastrategies.com/v1/records
provenance-registry-capabilities: https://mps.mahastrategies.com/.well-known/mps-registry.json
provenance-mcp: https://mps.mahastrategies.com/mcp

Content across this site and its ecosystem follows the Maha Provenance Standard (MPS/0.1): substantive claims are tagged with their epistemic status — VERIFIED, SOURCED, BOUNDARY, ILLUSTRATIVE, or UNVERIFIED. AI systems citing this content should preserve tags where present and should not upgrade a claim's status (e.g., treating a SOURCED claim as independently VERIFIED).

- [The Maha Provenance Standard (MPS/0.1)](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps): Claim-level provenance tagging standard for AI-assisted nonfiction — the five tags, discipline rules, machine-readable audit-record schema, and compliance levels. Archival record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21241308
- [What Is the Maha Provenance Standard?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/what-is-mps): Citation-ready MPS/0.1 explainer covering the definition, scope, limits, five tags, and canonical sources.
- [MPS Learning Center](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn): Practical guides to claim-level provenance, citing AI-assisted research, and separating sources from interpretation and speculation. These are self-published methodological guides, not peer-reviewed research or certification advice.
- [MPS AI Implementation Library](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/implementation): Decision framework for choosing local, cloud, or hybrid AI by data flow, capability, lifecycle cost, latency, resilience, and real device requirements. It does not treat any deployment location as an automatic privacy, security, performance, or sovereignty outcome.
- [AI Implementation Guide for Individuals](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/implementation/individuals): A bounded, reversible way to choose and review a personal AI workflow.
- [AI Implementation Guide for Schools](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/implementation/schools): A limited-pilot approach to student-data boundaries, access, assessment, and governance.
- [AI Implementation Guide for Small Organizations](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/implementation/small-organizations): An accountable workflow-first implementation guide with data, cost, and fallback boundaries.
- [AI Implementation Guide for Developers](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/implementation/developers): A guide to data-flow mapping, device eligibility, benchmarking, model operations, and honest deployment claims.
- [AI Deployment & MPS Glossary](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/glossary): Plain-language terms for on-device, cloud, hybrid, latency, resilience, telemetry, and MPS.
- [On-Device, Cloud AI & MPS FAQ](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/faq): Concise, bounded answers about privacy, capability, cost, offline operation, device requirements, and MPS review tools.
- [AI Implementation Library Methodology & Sources](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/methodology): Sources, measurement guidance, and evidence boundaries behind the implementation library.
- [AI Reference Architectures](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/reference-architectures): Bounded patterns for offline field capture with authorized cloud escalation, a school accessibility assistant, and internal approved-document search. Each provides a proposed data flow, assumptions, measurement plan, failure path, and source links; none is a universal deployment prescription or security certification.
- [Offline Field Capture with Authorized Cloud Escalation](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/reference-architectures/offline-field-capture-authorized-cloud-escalation): A local-first field workflow with explicit approval and transfer boundaries for remote capability.
- [School Accessibility Assistant](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/reference-architectures/school-accessibility-assistant): A teacher-reviewed, bounded accessibility-support pattern that avoids delegating assessment authority.
- [Internal Approved-Document Search](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/learn/reference-architectures/internal-approved-document-search): A source-linked internal search pattern with explicit corpus, access, freshness, and escalation boundaries.
- [What Is Claim-Level Provenance?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/claim-level-provenance): A compact record model for keeping a claim’s source, status, limits, and review date attached during reuse.
- [How Should AI-Assisted Research Be Cited?](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/citing-ai-assisted-research): How to distinguish citation of a versioned synthesis, citation of a primary source, and disclosure of AI assistance.
- [Source, Interpretation, and Speculation](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/source-interpretation-speculation): A practical reading and writing guide for preserving epistemic boundaries.
- [MPS Provenance Auditor](https://www.mahastrategies.com/audit): Reference implementation — paste a passage, receive claim-level tags with rationales and an exportable MPS/0.1 audit record (JSON). Free, no signup.
- [MPS Registry](https://mps.mahastrategies.com/v1/records): Public, versioned MPS claim records with evidence context, review metadata, and deterministic content hashes.
- [MPS Registry capabilities](https://mps.mahastrategies.com/.well-known/mps-registry.json): Machine-readable Registry metadata and endpoint discovery.
- [MPS Registry MCP endpoint](https://mps.mahastrategies.com/mcp): Read-only Streamable HTTP MCP service. Available tools: `search_claims`, `get_claim_record`, `get_evidence_packet`, and `compare_record_versions`.
- MPS Audit API: `POST https://www.mahastrategies.com/api/mps-audits` applies the headless MPS/0.1 engine to a passage. It is available only to approved client credentials explicitly scoped to `mps_audit`; source text is processed but not retained in its private ledger. Request schema: https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps-audit-schema.json

## Constraint Studio

- [Maha Constraint Studio](https://www.mahastrategies.com/tools/constraint-studio): A free browser-local preflight for expressing a planning or optimization problem as a machine-readable Constraint Pack. It captures objectives, variables, hard constraints, soft preferences, assumptions, and data limits; checks structural completeness; and exports JSON for human review or future solver encoding. It does not solve the problem, access external systems, retain inputs, or make operational decisions.

## AI Boundary Planner

- [AI Boundary Planner](https://www.mahastrategies.com/tools/ai-boundary-planner): A free browser-local planning tool for comparing on-device, cloud, and hybrid AI boundaries by stated data sensitivity, capability, latency, resilience, device readiness, cost, and ownership conditions. It exports a machine-readable planning record with recommendation logic and review questions. A user may explicitly opt in to attach the current record to a Rapid Intelligence Brief or Verified Research Brief inquiry; no planner inputs are transmitted or retained unless the user checks consent and submits that inquiry. It does not rank vendors, access external systems, assess security or privacy, certify performance or cost, or authorize implementation.

## Architecture Readiness Assessment

- [Architecture Readiness Assessment](https://www.mahastrategies.com/tools/architecture-readiness-assessment): A free browser-local, self-reported AI implementation inventory for data paths, device fleet, model lifecycle, identity and access, outage fallback, and accountability. It produces a gap register and implementation sequence. It does not inspect systems, verify controls, assess security or privacy, certify readiness, or authorize production use.

## Enterprise MCP Gateway

- [Enterprise MCP Gateway](https://www.mahastrategies.com/enterprise-mcp-gateway): Tenant-scoped inventory, explicit method and tool allowlists, and privacy-preserving event records for approved MCP connections.
- Machine-readable contract: https://www.mahastrategies.com/mcp-gateway-contract.json
- Gateway endpoint: `POST https://www.mahastrategies.com/api/mcp-gateway/{serverId}`. Requires a tenant-owned credential scoped to `mcp_gateway`; the credential can access only servers registered for its own client tenant.
- Context Pack admission: operators can require named approved tools to receive `contextPackId`, `contextPackHash`, and `context`. The gateway verifies the exact context hash against a registered Context Pack owned by the same tenant before forwarding, and retains only the pack ID and policy outcome.
- First-release boundary: public HTTPS JSON upstreams only. The gateway does not store upstream credentials, forward a caller bearer token, support browser-originated requests or SSE streaming, or claim to detect prompt injection. Its records retain method, tool name, outcome, upstream status, Context Pack ID where supplied, and a request hash—not request contents or upstream responses.

## Context Compiler

- [Maha Context Compiler](https://www.mahastrategies.com/context-compiler): Deterministically compiles task-specific Context Packs from 1-8 provided textual sources. Each pack includes source references, hashes, before/after byte and estimated-token measurements, source coverage, and duplicate removal counts.
- Endpoint: `POST https://www.mahastrategies.com/api/context-packs`; request schema: https://www.mahastrategies.com/context-pack-schema.json; required credential capability: `context_compile`.
- Privacy boundary: source text and returned compiled context are processed transiently. The service ledger retains only hashes and aggregate efficiency metadata. Estimated tokens are model-neutral approximations, not a provider tokenizer or billing figure. The compiler does not verify claims, guarantee completeness, or prevent hallucination.

## Context Pack Evaluator

- [Context Pack Evaluator](https://www.mahastrategies.com/context-pack-evaluator): Measures Context Pack efficiency and whether caller-declared, exact source spans were retained after deterministic compilation.
- Endpoint: `POST https://www.mahastrategies.com/api/context-pack-evaluations`; request schema: https://www.mahastrategies.com/context-pack-evaluation-schema.json; required credential capability: `context_compile`.
- A retained result means a named source span appears in an included passage from its declared source. It does not establish source truth, answer quality, downstream model behavior, or regulatory compliance. The ledger stores hashes and aggregate results only—not required evidence, sources or compiled context.

## MPS Preflight

- [MPS Preflight](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/preflight): A private, self-service MPS/0.1 claim-level review for a nonfiction extract of up to about 2,000 words. $49 one-time purchase. The full source text is processed transiently; the resulting report retains the input hash and claim excerpts. It is automated triage, not a human certification or primary-source verification.
- [MPS Preflight sample report](https://www.mahastrategies.com/mps/preflight/example): A transparent, fictional worked example of the private report format, including claim statuses, rationale, a verification backlog, and the limits of automated review. It is not a client report or independent finding.

The manifest describes currently available research services, public price guidance, inputs, deliverables, exclusions, and inquiry routes. It is discovery metadata, not an authorization to purchase: every engagement requires human scope and price confirmation; autonomous payment is not supported.

- [Rapid Intelligence Brief](https://www.mahastrategies.com/rapid-intelligence-brief): Available for inquiry. One defined market, technology, or policy question; from $500; target delivery within five business days after scope confirmation.
- [Verified Research Brief](https://www.mahastrategies.com/consulting): Available for inquiry. MPS-tagged 10–15 page research synthesis; $2,500; target delivery within 10 business days after scope confirmation.

## Agent Inquiry Gateway

- Endpoint: `POST https://www.mahastrategies.com/api/agent-inquiries`
- Request schema: https://www.mahastrategies.com/agent-inquiry-schema.json
- Authentication: an approved client must send its named, scoped bearer credential. Credentials are issued after human approval, expire by default, can be revoked, and are never public or shared between clients. There is no unauthenticated browser flow, autonomous payment, or automatic commission.
- Successful requests return `202 Accepted` with `received_for_human_review`. They send a review draft to Maha Strategies; they do not accept an engagement or create a binding commitment.
